# Cleveland 2011.53, Saint Paul initial

Saint Paul with sword and book, the initial P and its foliate extensions, from a Latin Bible leaf painted by William de Brailes in Oxford about 1230–1240, in the Cleveland Museum of Art.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `cma-2011-53`, historical, 6 assets, version 1.0.0.
